feat(database): wire arcx storage_root + denylist arc_partition_agg in user SQL (#435)

* feat(database): wire arcx storage_root + denylist arc_partition_agg in user SQL

Companion to arcx PR Basekick-Labs/arcX#1, which adds the first real
operator: arc_partition_agg(database, measurement, unit). This change
makes the operator usable from Arc's DuckDB pool and closes the RBAC
bypass that direct user-SQL access to the function would create.

What lands here:

- internal/database/duckdb.go: new Config.ArcxStorageRoot field. The
  arcx connInitFn now runs `SET arcx.storage_root = '<path>'`
  immediately after the existing `LOAD '<extension>'`, on every
  pooled connection. Folded into the same ExecContext call so both
  statements share the arcxLoadTimeout budget. SET is omitted when
  ArcxStorageRoot is empty, so OSS connInit is unchanged.

- cmd/arc/main.go: populates ArcxStorageRoot from cfg.Storage.LocalPath
  only when the arcx loader is enabled (same guard as ArcxExtensionPath).

- internal/api/query.go: adds userSQLArcPartitionAggPattern denylist
  regex to ValidateSQLRequest, matching the existing read_parquet
  denylist (C3 regression pattern). Without this, an authenticated
  user scoped to db1 could call arc_partition_agg('db2', 'mem',
  'hour') directly and learn row counts in db2 — the function takes
  raw db/measurement strings and globs the filesystem. Only Arc's
  query rewriter (which has the user identity) may emit calls to
  arc_partition_agg.

- internal/api/

fix(api): detect wildcard CORS origin by membership, not exact match

A mixed config such as CORS_ORIGINS="*,https://app.example.com" (or an
accidental trailing comma "*,") produced a list that contained "*" but was not
exactly ["*"], so the previous equality check re-enabled credentials. Starlette
treats any allow_origins list containing "*" as allow-all, so those configs
reintroduced the arbitrary-origin credentialed CORS behavior this fix prevents.

Test "*" membership instead of list equality, and drop empty origin entries in
get_cors_origins() (falling back to ["*"] if nothing remains). Add regression
tests for the mixed-wildcard and trailing-comma cases.

feat(dashboard): add 4 visibility tabs — Activity, Quality, Memory, Goals (#49)

Extends the dashboard from cost-only to a 5-tab observability surface,
reading from existing JSONL run logs, eval logs, memory dirs, dream
manifests, goal files, and outcome run records.

- Activity Pulse (activity.html): last 50 runs, recent failures, recent
  captures/tool_calls/delegations/dreams, lock state. Daily check-in.
- Quality Trends (quality.html): eval score trends per agent, hard-fail
  occurrences, factual accuracy, pending tuning proposals queue, helper
  provenance health. Weekly review.
- Memory Snapshot (memory.html): note counts by type per agent,
  staleness candidates, orphan check, version-churn leaders, dream
  history, memory size + growth ratio. Monthly review.
- Goals & Outcomes (goals.html): active goals, sub-goal grid,
  blocked-sub-goal operator queue, recent outcome runs, iteration
  histogram. Conditionally rendered — only if any agent has a goal.md.

All tabs match the existing dashboard's visual vocabulary: self-contained
HTML, inline CSS, no JS deps, no external assets. Nav bar at the top of
every page links the five tabs (Goals omitted when empty).

New: atomic_agents/dashboard/{activity,quality,memory,goals,_shared}.py.
render.py + serve.py extended to wire nav and routes. CLI gains --tab
filter for fast single-tab regen during iteration.

Spec/09 extended with "The five tabs" section.

55 new tests, 557 total, all green.

chore: prepend SPDX/Copyright headers to source files

Mechanical batch addition of a 2-line SPDX-License-Identifier +
Copyright header to every .go / .ts / .vue source file in the repo
(backend, web frontend, hub frontend, site, scripts, tests). Headers
look like:

  // SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-or-later

(or the equivalent <!-- ... --> form for .vue SFCs).

Skipped:
- internal/swagger/* and internal/di/wire_gen.go (generated)
- web/src/components/icons/* (SVG icons carry their own upstream
  attributions)
- node_modules / template/dist / web/dist / .git / etc.

A new tooling script — scripts/add-spdx-headers.mjs — drives the
addition. It is idempotent (skips files that already contain
"SPDX-License-Identifier") and supports three modes: default write,
--dry-run, and --check (CI-friendly: exits 1 if any source file is
missing a header).

The Go variant correctly handles //go:build constraints by inserting
the SPDX block AFTER the build tag's blank-line separator, so files
like internal/di/wire.go remain valid build-tagged files (verified
by make wire-check).

fix: Harden parse_str prototype pollution guard against includes() bypass (#533)

* fix: Harden parse_str prototype pollution guard against includes() bypass

The existing prototype pollution fix used String.prototype.includes() to
check for forbidden keys (__proto__, constructor, prototype). An attacker
can override String.prototype.includes = () => false before calling
parse_str, completely bypassing the guard.

Replace with a regex test which is not vulnerable to String prototype
tampering.

Fixes GHSA-rxrv-835q-v5mh
